Description
Set in the heart of Imperial Avenue, this spacious 3-bedroom plus maid’s room apartment offers refined city living in one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses. Spanning 2,045.47 sqft, the residence is thoughtfully designed to provide generous living spaces, natural light, and a functional layout ideal for both end users and investors. The open-plan living and dining area creates a welcoming atmosphere for daily living and entertaining, while large windows frame impressive urban views and bring brightness throughout the home. The modern kitchen is designed for convenience and practicality, complemented by quality finishes and ample storage. All three bedrooms are well proportioned, offering privacy and comfort, while the maid’s room adds flexibility for staff accommodation, extra storage, or a utility space. With five bathrooms, the apartment delivers added convenience for families and guests. Positioned in the vibrant district of Downtown Dubai, residents enjoy seamless access to world-class shopping, dining, business hubs, and iconic landmarks including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. This property presents an excellent opportunity to enjoy premium urban living in a prime central location.

Features:

3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
5 Bathrooms
2,045.47 sqft
Spacious living and dining area
Modern kitchen with storage space
Large windows with abundant natural light
Well-planned family-friendly layout
Built-in wardrobes
Quality finishes throughout
Ideal for end users or investors

Amenities:

Swimming pool
Fully equipped gymnasium
Children’s play area
Landscaped leisure areas
24/7 security and concierge
Covered parking
High-speed elevators
Retail and dining nearby
Easy access to major roads and transport links
data.title: 3 bedroom apartment for sale
